text356: If a material change occurs, such as a change of payment provider or the addition of a type of data processed, this page and its date will be updated, and parents with active accounts will be notified by email.
text354: Passwords are stored as hashes and cannot be read back, even by administrators. Access to the admin panel and teacher dashboard is restricted by role. Changes to attendance or grades beyond **7 days** after the initial entry require a correction request to an administrator, recorded in the system.
text352: Parent accounts can still be deleted; data that must be archived will be **anonymized**, rather than destroyed.
text351: Invoices, payments, and refund requests are retained according to the institution’s bookkeeping obligations.
text350: Children with an **enrollment history** cannot be deleted through self-service because transaction records must remain intact for financial audits.
text349: You may request correction or deletion of your own or your child’s data by contacting an administrator. The following conditions apply:
text347: Personal data is not shared with third parties except as necessary to provide the service: **Midtrans** as payment processor, transactional email providers for notifications, and Siedu staff according to their roles (administrators and teachers), who only receive access to class or enrollment data under their responsibility.
text345: Online payments are processed by **Midtrans**. Siedu does not receive, store, or access your card or bank account details; our system only stores transaction status, payment method, and amount. Installments are paid manually without automatic withdrawals. Enrollments not fully paid within **24 hours** are automatically canceled and their seats released.
text343: Data is used solely for operational purposes: class enrollment and scheduling (capacity checks and schedule conflict checks), billing and payment reconciliation, attendance and grade recording by teachers, status notifications to parents, and institutional administrative reports such as enrollment, overdue payment, and refund summaries. Data is not used beyond these purposes.

text325: This policy explains how Siedu collects, uses, stores, and protects the personal data of parents and children, along with the rights attached to that data. Each main topic has its own section for easy reference. This document is an operational summary, not a final legal document.
text402: These terms are governed by the **laws of the Republic of Indonesia**. Disputes will first be addressed through discussion before other avenues are pursued.

text396: Siedu is an administrative tool for enrollment and learning. Teaching quality and the delivery of classes are the responsibility of the institution and its teachers. We are not liable for losses resulting from inaccurate information you submit.
text394: The institution may adjust schedules, replace teachers, or cancel classes, including when minimum enrollment is not met. If a class is canceled after payment, it is handled under the refund terms in section 6.
text393: 8. Changes or cancellations by the institution
text392: Teachers record children’s attendance and progress grades. Within **7 days of the initial entry**, teachers may make corrections themselves. After that deadline, changes require a **correction request** to an administrator so the history is recorded.
text390: Refunds are carried out manually by an administrator outside the system after approval.
text389: Outside these conditions, cancellation is treated as a regular cancellation without a down payment refund.
text388: Full refunds are only available for four verified conditions: **system errors**, **incorrect transfer amounts**, **incorrect bank accounts**, and **incorrect class selection**.
text387: Voluntary cancellation: the **down payment is forfeited** and non-refundable.
text386: Cancellation requests can be submitted from the enrollment details page. Refund approval is at the administrator’s discretion and follows the cancellation reason category.
text384: Overdue balances exceeding **7 business days** cause enrollment to be canceled and handled by an administrator.
text383: If no successful payment is received within **24 hours**, enrollment is automatically canceled and the seat is released.
text382: Online payments are processed through **Midtrans**; if the channel is unavailable, the system displays manual bank transfer instructions.
text381: Installments are manual with **no automatic withdrawals**. The minimum term is 2 (the down payment plus at least one installment) and cannot exceed the class’s maximum term.
text380: Classes without a down payment option must be paid **in full**.
text379: The first invoice is issued automatically upon enrollment. Available payment plans are payment in full or a down payment with manual installments, according to the options offered by the class.
text377: Enrollment follows the currently open **term**; outside that term, no classes are available to select.
text376: Schedules that **conflict** with another active class (the same day with overlapping times) are rejected by the system.
text375: **Seats are reserved** when enrollment is created; full classes cannot be enrolled in.
text374: Classes are only shown for a child when the **education level matches** that child’s level.
text373: The system automatically enforces the following when an enrollment is created:
text371: This service is provided for class enrollment, scheduling, payments, and monitoring children’s attendance and grades. Use for other purposes, including falsifying data, attempting to access another person’s account, or disrupting the system, is not permitted.

text368: Complete your child’s profile, including education level, before enrolling, as class eligibility is based on this information.
text367: Only register children who are genuinely under your responsibility. During registration, you declare that you are the child’s **legal guardian**.
text366: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity on your account. Information submitted during enrollment is considered accurate and verifiable.
text364: One parent account may enroll more than one child. Each enrollment is independent and subject to the terms below.
text363: These terms apply to **parent** accounts enrolling children through Siedu. Teachers and administrators are institutional staff whose accounts are created by administrators; their roles are governed separately and are not subject to the parent enrollment sections.
